typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::gv_GetCnt',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBPSDCNT	source(output(
		COL_XML as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: '[Invoice].[Pr_GenerateXML_Inv_PSD] 	@BatchId = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBTCFileDataBOSS
SRCOLEDBPSDCNT sink(input(
		Column_0 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = COUNT)) ~> FlatFileDestination
SRCOLEDBTCFileDataBOSS derive({Copy of COL_XML} = toString(COL_XML)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		COL_XML as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		COL_XML = {Copy of COL_XML})) ~> DSTFFTCFileXML
